Changelog

What's new in agterm

Every release, newest first. agterm updates itself; the same notes appear in its What's New tab.

1.2.12

November 11, 2026

  • FixedA Codex tab is named after its conversation (Codex's thread name, or your first prompt) instead of its folder.
  • FixedGPT model names read "GPT-5.1 Codex Max" instead of "gpt-5.1-codex-max".

1.2.11

November 9, 2026

  • FixedA Codex tab's tokens, cost and changed lines in the sidebar and the Chat view's title strip now include its subagents and auto-review threads.
  • FixedWhen Codex starts a subagent, the tab's Chat view and totals stay on the tab's own session instead of switching to the subagent's.
  • FixedTeams counts a Codex subagent's usage as part of the session that started it, on that session's login, not as another session.

1.2.10

November 9, 2026

  • FixedClaude Fable 5.2 turns now have a cost in the sidebar, the Chat view, Usage and Teams. Before, they showed tokens only.
  • Addedagterm downloads model prices daily, so a new model's cost shows without waiting for an agterm update.
  • FixedWhen a Claude Code or Codex login runs out of usage, the tab moves to your next login within a few seconds, instead of sitting at the limit message for about 20 seconds first.

1.2.9

November 9, 2026

  • FixedA Claude Code tab's tokens, cost and changed lines in the sidebar and the Chat view's title strip now include its subagents and workflows.
  • FixedUsage counts the agents a Claude Code workflow runs, and Teams counts Claude Code subagents and workflows. Neither counts them as extra sessions.

1.2.8

November 9, 2026

  • FixedIn the Chat view, the title strip's context window, tokens, cost and changed lines no longer all disappear when they don't fit. The tokens and cost go first, then the changed lines; the context window stays.
  • AddedThe Chat view's title strip shows the tab's name after the agent's.

1.2.7

November 9, 2026

  • AddedIn the Chat view, the title strip shows how full the agent's context window is (184k / 1M), for Claude Code, Codex and Grok.
  • AddedThe Chat view shows files an agent wrote or edited through its shell as diffs, like its other edits: cat > file <<'EOF' writes, and Python scripts that replace text in a file.
  • ChangedThe Chat view folds finished commands that ran one after another into one line (Ran 3 shell commands). Click it to see the commands, and a command to see its output. Running and failed commands still show in full.
  • FixedThe Chat view stops following new messages when you scroll away with the scroller or the keyboard, not only the wheel, and stays at the end when the text finishes laying out or the view gets shorter. Opening a row at the end keeps that row in place.

1.2.6

November 8, 2026

  • Fixedagterm Remote's Chat view no longer leaves blank gaps between tool rows and before replies.
  • FixedThe Chat view no longer leaves a band of empty space between the last message and the status line above the message box.
  • FixedAn open Chat view no longer keeps scrolling itself to the end in the background, which used CPU while nothing changed.

1.2.5

November 8, 2026

  • Fixedagterm Remote's Chat view no longer runs paragraphs together, or shows ** around bold text, when a reply has a stray backtick (such as the one in the ⌃ backtick shortcut). Each paragraph and list item now keeps its own formatting.

1.2.4

November 8, 2026

  • AddedWhen the tabs kept from before an update still run in a session helper the update replaced, agterm says at launch that they've lost Full Disk Access (agents there get "Operation not permitted" in Documents) and offers Quit and End Sessions. Helpers started by 1.2.1 or later aren't affected.
  • AddedTyping / in the Chat view's message box lists the agent's commands with what each does, and narrows the list as you type, as Claude Code, Codex, Grok and agl do in the terminal. The list includes your skills, custom commands, Codex prompts and Claude Code plugin commands for the tab's folder. ↑↓ move, ⇥ fills the name in, ⏎ runs it and Esc closes the list.
  • AddedTyping @ in the Chat view's message box lists the files and folders in the tab's folder, for Claude Code, Codex and Grok. Keep typing to narrow the list; ⇥ or ⏎ fills the path in.
  • AddedPaste or drop an image into the Chat view's message box to send it to Claude Code, Codex or Grok. It shows as [Image #1] until you send.
  • Added↑ in the Chat view's empty message box brings back messages you sent earlier, and ↓ goes forward again.
  • FixedWhen an agent shows a picker or a question in the Chat view (/model, /resume), you can answer it there: ↑↓←→, ⏎ and ⇥ from the empty message box go to the agent. Before, you had to switch to the terminal.

1.2.3

November 8, 2026

  • Changedagl looks cleaner. A new conversation opens with a short welcome showing the model, where it runs and the folder. Tool calls read as Read, Edit (with the lines changed), Write and Run (with the first lines of output). A spinner line shows what's running and for how long, and the footer shows how much of the model's context is used. Typing / lists every command with what it does.
  • FixedClosing an agl tab, or switching models in agl, unloads the model agl made Ollama or LM Studio load, so it stops using memory. Models you loaded yourself, or that another agl tab is using, stay loaded. agl's own model server also stops when its tab closes, even if agl is killed.

1.2.2

November 8, 2026

  • AddedThe Chat view shows subagents and Claude Code workflows as rows of their own: what each was asked to do, its kind of agent or workflow name, and whether it's still running. Background agents and workflows stay running until they finish, then show how long they took; click the row to read what they came back with. Works for Claude Code's agents and workflows, Codex's spawned agents and Grok's subagents, and agterm Remote shows background ones as running too.
  • Addedagterm now comes with agl, the coding agent for local models. Type agl in any tab, or pick it in Shell → New Tab With Agent; it uses models from Ollama, LM Studio or its own library (agl models).
  • FixedThe Usage window opens in seconds instead of a minute or more on a Mac with a lot of Claude Code history. It now reads transcripts on every core and skips the tool output lines, which never hold token counts.
  • FixedThe buttons at the top right (worktrees, hand off, commit, usage, changes, session timeline) and the tab bar's buttons show their tooltips when you hover over them.

1.2.1

November 8, 2026

  • FixedTabs kept running across an update or reinstall no longer lose Full Disk Access and agterm's other privacy permissions. The sessions helper now runs from its own copy of agterm, which updates don't replace. Tabs started before this version still need agterm → Quit and End Sessions once.

1.2.0

November 8, 2026

  • AddedThe first launch after updating to 1.2 opens a welcome window: what's new since 1.1.7 by group, with switches for keeping the Mac awake while agents run, letting agents coordinate, and anonymous usage counts, a Set Up… button for your other Macs, and each feature's shortcut. Reopen it any time from agterm → Welcome to agterm 1.2….
  • AddedRun agents' heavy commands on another Mac. On the Mac that should do the work, turn on Settings → Macs → "Let my other Macs run tasks on this Mac" and copy its pairing code; paste it in Settings → Macs on your main Mac. Agents in agterm tabs are then told to run builds, test suites and other heavy commands there with agterm-remote run -- <command>: it copies the project over (git-ignored files such as node_modules and .env stay put), runs the command there, shows its output in the tab as it runs and exits with its status. Add --back to copy the results back. Ctrl-C stops it on the other Mac too. The connection is encrypted with a key from the pairing code, and the other Mac keeps accepting tasks after agterm quits there.
  • Addedagl, the local-model coding agent, is a known agent. Start it from Shell → New Tab With Agent, read its conversation in the Chat view and on agterm Remote, and a tab running agl comes back with its conversation after a restart.

1.1.8

November 8, 2026

  • AddedPin tabs. Right-click a tab and choose Pin Tab: it moves to the top of the sidebar (or the start of the tab bar), shows a pin, and stays above the other tabs when you drag or open new ones, including after a relaunch. Unpin Tab puts it back below the pinned ones.
  • AddedClaude Code and Codex agents started in agterm are told that the consult tools let them see every other agent running in agterm on this Mac, ask one about its work and leave it a message, and are encouraged to check before editing, committing or switching branches in a repo another agent is using. A Codex config that sets its own developer_instructions is left alone.
  • AddedChat view for Claude Code, Codex and Grok tabs. Press ⌃ (View → Chat), or click Chat in the strip above the tab, to read the conversation as a transcript: replies with formatting, folded file reads, edits as diffs, commands with their results and errors. Type in the box at the bottom to message the agent; Esc interrupts it. Approval prompts show as buttons; menus Chat can't read show the bottom of the screen, and ⌃ takes you back to the terminal. The agent keeps running in its terminal either way, and each pane of a split keeps its own view.
  • Changedagterm Remote reads Claude Code and Codex transcripts only as far as they grew since the last read.
  • Changedagterm uses much less memory with many agents running. Teams usage sync and tab titles read only what was added to each transcript instead of whole files, and agterm Remote forgets a conversation once you close it on your phone.
  • ChangedGit status for busy tabs that aren't on screen is checked every 15 seconds instead of every 3, so agterm starts far fewer git processes. Tabs you can see still update every 3 seconds.
  • Addedagterm sends anonymous usage counts so we can see how many people use it and which features matter: a random ID made on your Mac, agterm's and macOS's versions, the processor type, which agents start in your tabs, and how often you split a tab, open the command bar, open a cloud tab, pair a phone or install an update. Never files, folders, commands, what you type, repository names or account details. Turn it off in Settings → General → Privacy.
  • AddedWindow → Team Dashboard shows your agterm Teams team without agmux: tokens, estimated cost, active time and sessions over 7 to 90 days, daily usage, the monthly budget, providers and models, every member's usage and spend, and projects. Click a member to see their numbers and which Claude or Codex login did the work. Employees see their own numbers. It loads when you open it or press Refresh, and shows the last numbers it got while you're offline. Settings → Teams & Phone has a Team Dashboard… button too.
  • AddedTeam owners, and managers for the logins they added, can rename, pause and remove the team's shared Codex and Grok logins in the Team Dashboard.
  • AddedSession Timeline (View → Session Timeline, ⇧⌘L, or the list button at the top right). It lists every prompt you sent in the tab with Claude Code, Codex or Grok, newest first, with whether it's running, done, failed or cancelled and how long ago. Click one to scroll the terminal to where that turn starts; it flashes briefly. In a plain shell tab it lists the commands you ran.
  • AddedInstall agterm with Homebrew: brew install --cask neel-xanom/agmux/agterm.
  • AddedView → Command Palette (⇧⌘P). Type a few letters of any menu command or open tab, then press Return to run it or switch to that tab. Each command shows its menu and shortcut.
  • AddedKeep Mac Awake While Agents Run, in the agterm menu and Settings → Agents. While an agent tab is working, your Mac doesn't sleep on its own; it sleeps normally again once no agent is working. Turn on "Also when the lid is closed" to keep it awake with the lid shut too. That asks for an administrator's password once, to install a small helper, and agterm shows a notification when it's keeping the Mac awake on battery.
  • Changedagterm runs its own project memory and consult servers for every agent, even with agmux installed, so you can uninstall agmux without losing memory. Repos agmux knows keep reading and writing agmux's memory where it is; nothing is copied or moved.
  • AddedOpenCode, Kilo Code, Cursor Agent and Amp started in agterm get project memory and consult too, for that run only, without changes to their settings files. OpenCode, Kilo Code and Cursor Agent are also told how to use the memory.
  • ChangedGit repos agmux doesn't know get their own memory even when agmux is installed.
  • AddedShell → Search Conversations… (⇧⌘F) finds past Claude Code, Codex and Grok conversations by what you or the agent wrote in them, across every login agterm manages. Each result shows the agent, the conversation's title, its folder, when it last ran and the text around the match. Pick one with the arrow keys and press Return to reopen it in a new tab in its folder.
  • Changedagmux Teams is now agterm Teams, at teams.agterm.dev. You stay signed in, your team, usage history and shared logins are unchanged, and agmux keeps working with the same team. Links to teams.agmux.dev open the new address.
  • AddedButtons at the top right of the window, each explained in its tooltip: show changes, commit, worktrees, hand off, usage, and the branch's pull request once there is one.
  • AddedShow Changes (⇧⌘E) opens a panel beside the terminal with every changed file and its diff. Pick Agent (what the agent in the tab changed since it started), Uncommitted, or Branch (everything since the branch left main). It updates as the agent edits and reads nothing while it's closed. Drag its edge to resize it.
  • AddedCommit (⌥⌘C) drafts a commit message with the same fast model as ⌘K, then commits, commits and pushes, or commits, pushes and opens a pull request with a written title and description, in one step. On main, opening a pull request first moves your work to a new branch and leaves main as it was. Pull requests need the GitHub CLI (gh).
  • AddedNew Worktree Tab (⇧⌘N) starts an agent on a new branch in a folder of its own under ~/.agterm/worktrees, with your .env files copied in and an optional first task. A repo can add .agterm/worktree-setup.sh to install dependencies first. Remove This Worktree asks before deleting anything and says what would be lost.
  • AddedHand Off continues an agent's conversation in Claude Code, Codex, Grok or Gemini CLI, in a new tab beside it.
  • AddedUsage (⇧⌘U) shows tokens and estimated cost by day, model and project for Claude Code and Codex on this Mac, and how much of each login's limits is left.

1.1.7

November 8, 2026

  • FixedStarting claude in a folder that was deleted or that macOS blocks agterm from reading no longer hangs and uses up tens of gigabytes of memory; claude starts normally.
  • Changedagterm uses far less CPU while Claude Code and Codex run. It reads only the new part of each session's transcript, not the whole file every few seconds, checks git only in folders where something happened, and agterm Remote loads a conversation only while you have it open on your phone.

1.1.6

November 7, 2026

  • ChangedSplit Right (⌘D) and Split Down (⇧⌘D) open an empty pane that lists your other tabs. Pick one, or click a tab in the tab bar or sidebar, to show it there, or choose New Shell. Every tab in a split keeps its own place in the tabs and is highlighted while the split is on screen; the one you're typing in has the accent bar.
  • AddedRight-click a tab that isn't on screen and choose Show to the Right or Show Below to put it beside the current tab. Shell → Unsplit, or Unsplit on a split tab's menu, puts every pane back in a tab of its own; Move to Own Tab does it for one. Nothing closes.
  • Changed⌘W closes the tab you're typing in, including one in a split; Close Pane and ⇧⌘W are gone.
  • AddedThe sidebar and the title above the terminal show each agent's logo.
  • ChangedWith more tabs than fit, sidebar tabs drop the spend and run time line, then the agent line, so more fit on screen.
  • ChangedThe sidebar is the terminal's color and its first tab sits right under the window buttons.
  • FixedIn a see-through window, a strip between the sidebar and the terminal showed what was behind the window.
  • FixedAn agent's run time counts from when it started, not from when agterm last opened.
  • FixedTabs in your home folder show ~ in the sidebar.

1.1.5

November 7, 2026

  • AddedSplit a tab into panes, as in Warp. Shell → Split Right (⌘D) or Split Down (⇧⌘D) opens a new shell beside or below the one you're typing in, in the same folder. Drag the line between panes to resize them, and move between panes with ⌘[ and ⌘] or ⌥⌘ and the arrow keys. Panes you aren't typing in are dimmed. ⌘W closes the pane you're in and ⇧⌘W closes the whole tab. Your panes and their sizes come back the next time you open agterm.
  • AddedView → Tabs on the Left (⌃⌘S) moves your tabs to a sidebar with more room for each one. A Claude Code or Codex tab shows its model (such as Opus 4.5), what it has spent so far in dollars and tokens, and how long it has been running, next to its status, folder and lines changed. A tab split into panes shows how many it has, and its dot shows whichever pane most needs you.

1.1.4

November 6, 2026

  • AddedWhen Claude Code stops because it couldn't reach Anthropic (no internet, Wi-Fi changing, the Mac sleeping mid-response), agterm types "Continue where you left off." as soon as the connection is back, unless you've typed in the tab since. Turn it off in Settings → Agents.
  • AddedClick in the command you're typing at a zsh prompt to move the cursor there, instead of using the arrow keys.
  • Fixedcd suggestions find folders four levels inside your home folder, such as ~/Downloads/InFocus/Show Resources/InFocus 2026 Package. They used to stop at three.

1.1.3

November 6, 2026

  • Addedagmux Teams can split your usage by login. agterm now notes which Claude Code or Codex login each session runs on, including after an automatic account switch, and sends that with the hourly totals, so the Teams dashboard shows how many tokens went through each login. Logins appear as an opaque ID; a Claude login's email is sent only when your team's owner turns on Shared Claude accounts. Sessions started before this update stay unsplit.

1.1.2

November 6, 2026

  • FixedTeams cost estimates price Claude Haiku 5.5, including its higher rate for prompts over 100,000 tokens, which were left out before. Claude Sonnet 5.5 cache reads are counted at $0.10 per million tokens, not $0.20.

1.1.1

November 4, 2026

  • AddedAgents in agterm tabs coordinate with each other. consult tells every Claude Code, Codex and Grok agent how: a board per repo where they claim what they take on (a migration number, a file, a branch), ask everyone ("is anyone changing auth.ts?"), reply, and record decisions, and direct messages to one agent. They check the board when they start, before taking anything shared, and before finishing; claims expire after 4 hours unless renewed. With team sessions on, the board and the agents are shared with your teammates' agents; otherwise it covers the agents on this Mac.
  • AddedA teammate's agent can ask a Codex or Grok tab a question, as well as a Claude Code one. The read-only copy that answers has no tools, so it answers from the conversation alone.
  • ChangedSettings → Teams & Phone → Team Sessions is now "Let my agents coordinate with my team's agents".
  • Fixedconsult's list_sessions and send_message work in agterm tabs without agmux running. They list this Mac's agent tabs and type the message into the agent, marked as coming from another agent.

1.1.0

November 4, 2026

  • AddedTeam sessions. In Settings → Teams & Phone, members of an agmux team can share their agent tabs with teammates who also turn it on. Their agents then see your tabs' titles, folders, branches and status, and can ask a read-only copy of a Claude Code tab a question; the copy runs on your Mac and reads only that tab's conversation and the files in its folder. If you also allow messages, a teammate's agent can type a short note into your agent, marked as coming from them. Your agents get the same tools: list_team_sessions, ask_team_session and message_team_session in consult.
  • AddedIn Settings → Accounts, Use for New Sessions in an account's ⋯ menu makes new Claude Code, Codex or Grok sessions start on that account instead of your own login. Tabs already running stay where they are, and automatic switching still moves off it when it runs out.
  • AddedBeta updates. Paste a beta key in Settings → General → Updates and agterm installs beta builds as well as stable releases, whichever is newer. Leave Beta goes back to stable releases.
  • FixedAn agent asking a copy of another Claude Code session with consult gets an answer when that session was started without permission prompts. It used to get an error.
  • FixedA Grok tab that finishes while you're in another tab shows done instead of needs you. It shows needs you when Grok is waiting for your answer.
  • FixedA Grok tab keeps showing working while Grok runs a long command or waits on a subagent, including right after agterm reopens. Before, it could look finished while Grok was still going.
  • FixedA Grok tab no longer flips back to working after Grok finishes, such as when Grok names the conversation a few seconds later or while you type your next message. Its title also drops the trailing "- grok".
  • FixedOpening agterm from inside one of its tabs no longer stops Claude from saving conversations, and tab status no longer flips between working and done afterwards.
  • FixedDropping a dragged tab leaves it where you dropped it, instead of the tabs appearing to swap a second time.
  • FixedWhile you drag a tab, the tabs it passes over no longer light up as if the mouse were over them.

1.0.9

October 30, 2026

  • FixedGrok tabs show only the conversation's topic, without Grok's status ("- Thinking -", "- Waiting for response... -") in front of it.

1.0.8

October 29, 2026

  • AddedRight-click a tab (or Control-click it) to rename it, open a new tab in its folder, copy the folder's path, show the folder in Finder, or close the tab. Shell → Rename Tab… renames the current tab.
  • AddedA renamed tab keeps its name after agterm quits and reopens. Clear the name to go back to the program's own title.

1.0.7

October 26, 2026

  • FixedForce quitting a browser or other app that an agent opened from a tab no longer ends every tab's shell. Force quitting agterm itself leaves them running too. Tabs already open keep the old behavior until you choose agterm → Quit and End Sessions.

1.0.6

October 26, 2026

  • FixedA tab shows "needs you" when Claude Code asks you a question with choices (such as a list of questions to answer), instead of "done" or no status.
  • FixedThe tab bar stays visible when the window is in full screen.

1.0.5

October 26, 2026

  • Addedagmux Teams cost estimates price GPT-6.1 Terra at OpenAI's list rates.

1.0.4

October 26, 2026

  • FixedText stays readable in light themes such as Paper when a program colors it for a dark background. Claude Code's default theme wrote white and pale gray text that was hard to see.
  • AddedPrograms that follow the terminal's light or dark mode, like Claude Code with its theme set to Auto (/theme), switch along with agterm's theme.
  • AddedGrok accounts in Settings → Accounts, with their weekly usage and automatic switching. While Grok runs, agterm checks its usage every minute; when the account runs out, the same conversation continues on the account with the most left.
  • AddedGrok logins shared in agmux Teams are borrowed once all of yours are out, like Codex ones.
  • AddedTeam owners and managers can add Codex and Grok accounts to their agmux Teams pool from Settings → Accounts → Add Team Account….

1.0.3

October 26, 2026

  • Changed⌘K sends the model the tab's last 150 lines, scrollback included, so requests like "fix that error" or "run that again" work on commands that have scrolled off the screen.
  • FixedThe cd folder list also shows up for names of several words, like cd show resources for a folder named Show Resources.

1.0.2

October 26, 2026

  • AddedTabs keep running when agterm quits (⌘Q), updates or crashes, and come back live next time. Closing the window ends its tabs, and agterm → Quit and End Sessions ends them all and quits. Tabs stay running through updates from this version on; this update still restarts them.
  • AddedAfter an update, a new tab shows what changed since your last version; agterm → What's New… shows every release.
  • AddedThe New Agent Tab shortcut can be changed in Settings → Agents.
  • FixedThe Settings toolbar now fits all seven panes.
  • FixedPicking a theme such as Paper applies right away.
  • FixedThe cd folder list shows Tab to pick and takes clicks.
  • Fixed⌘K opens under the line you're typing on and no longer shrinks the window.
  • FixedTabs restored after a quit keep their emoji and the spacing of text drawn with gaps.

1.0.1

October 25, 2026

  • AddedMemory and consult work without agmux installed.

1.0.0

October 25, 2026

  • Addedagterm Remote, an iPhone app made for agterm.
  • AddedFolder suggestions while you type cd.
  • FixedClaude tabs get their name from the transcript when the session started with a slash command.
  • ChangedFaster bulk output, and one notification when a command with pauses finishes.

0.6.0

October 25, 2026

  • AddedBorrow Codex logins from agmux Teams when yours are out.
  • AddedCodex and other agent CLIs are restored on relaunch.
  • FixedTabs drag without moving the window.

0.5.0

October 25, 2026

  • AddedAutomatic account switching for Claude Code and Codex.
  • AddedStatus shows when Claude is busy.

0.4.0

October 25, 2026

  • AddedSettings panes, agent quick launch, permission bypass, and a ⌘K command bar.
  • AddedQuick launch for 20 agent CLIs.
  • AddedOn-screen permission prompts.
